items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was fortunate enough to work and also recorded with ... Buddy Rich

ctx.x: Of those that you just named which influenced you the most?
All of them. They all had their different style and arrangements, and musicians. I was

fortunate enough to work and also recorded with Count Basie when I came here to the United States, with Count Basie, with Stan Kenton, Duke Ellington with Tommy Dorsey, with Woody Herman, with Buddy Rich - those were the bands that were heard there in Cuba.
